title: Giant Caramel Cookie
description: A crumbly, cakey giant cookie made with salted butter, golden syrup and self-raising flour. Served whole like a pie or sliced into wedges.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan and grease a 20cm round pie dish.
Cream the butter and 5 tablespoons of the syrup together in a bowl until pale and fluffy. Sift in the flour and mix well.
Put the cookie dough into the pie dish and use the back of a spoon to spread it to the edge. Drizzle the remaining tablespoon of golden syrup over the top.
Bake for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Allow to cool completely in the dish before sliding out and slicing like a pie.
notes: Serves 6, or one very hungry person! Uses a 20cm round pie dish.
